attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter, stated as his view.

semantics.note: The claim keeps the mechanism (enabled burn rate) and the result (doomed). 'I believe' states a firm opinion, not a hedge. 'Doomed' looks forward but gives no date.

contract.note: Reading 'doomed' as eventual business failure caused by enabled overspending is the ordinary reading. Requiring an actual failure plus causal evidence for support, or durable self-financing for contradiction, is balanced.

evidence.note: OpenAI's own disclosure of a $122B round closed March 2026. It counts against an already-realised collapse but says nothing about eventual failure or its cause.
Nvidia 10-Q risk factor on contingent exposure if OpenAI fails to perform or becomes insolvent. It describes a risk, not a default or failure.

reviews.rationale: There is no failure event in the packet and no causal evidence linking enabled spending to unavoidable failure. Continued funding is not durable self-financing, so the claim is not contradicted either. The evidence available by the cutoff does not settle it.

attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter.

semantics.note: The antecedent (running up against a wall, i.e. capacity limits) is kept. 'Will end' is firm language. No deadline is given.

contract.note: The speaker named no threshold. Reading 'streak ends' as a material deterioration in reliability linked to capacity pressure is a fair and ordinary reading, but it is an evaluator interpretation. Under a looser 'any big outage' reading, the June 2025 incident might matter, though it is not tied to capacity.

evidence.note: Altman post of March 30, 2025, acknowledging demand strain. It bears on the antecedent, not the outcome, so it is context, not support.
Status page record of the June 10, 2025 multi-hour elevated-error incident. It is one incident with no capacity attribution and no sustained uptime series.

reviews.rationale: No deadline was given. Capacity strain is documented, but the packet has no comparable availability series showing a sustained decline, and nothing attributes the one outage to capacity. Absence of the event is not failure under an open horizon, so the claim is unresolved.
